name: THE ONE WHO KNOWS
note: HOB AT THE BACK (doc 05: 'At the back, not singing: Hob, hat in hand'). Cut from room-31's composition master by tools/art/room31-cast.py; examined through THE ONE WHO KNOWS over him. After doc 48 S2 beat 3 -- 'Good turnout.' Beat. 'Better than mine.' -- and he walks': off the hill to the right, on room-31 operation 3's walk (errata 99 G).
barksNote: Hob's lines here are beat 3's, spoken through the room (doc 48 S2).

exit.note: Doc 48 S2 beat 3: 'and he walks.' Off the hill at the right, unhurried, his hat in his hand (room-31 operation 3, cut by tools/art/cut-walk-sheet.py).
exit.redrawn: Cast-unify 31, a four-frame walk to the right, hat in hand, relit once from its day drawing. The walk it replaces had been relit in place by every run of tools/art/room31-night.py until it was solid blue (0,0,136).

sprite.frameNote: 0 watching, hat in hand · 1 breath (derived) · 2 head bowed · 3 a glance down to the left · 4 the hat to his chest.
sprite.statureNote: Tall (the master drew him a head over the mourners, 368 where the curve's man is 334); held to 1.04, inside the 5% a standing man is allowed (tests/scale.test.ts), so he is drawn 6% under the master.
sprite.redrawn: Errata 101 X (Tyler, 2026-11-06: 'The old man is super weirdly short and stout. The man in the blue jacket is a bad cutout.'). Drawn on magenta by cast-unify 31 (reference/cast-unify-29.txt) at ordinary lean proportions, as tall as Thad, cut with its own pixels and a clean edge, and relit into the funeral's night (tools/art/room31-relight-one.py). Hob, from his own art: his dark coat, his hat in his hand. The old cut from the composition master kept hillside between his legs and a ragged edge.
